verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own docs say users can delegate infrastructure work to Pulumi Agents/Neo, which executes changes and monitors outcomes automatically, and can maintain infrastructure. That gives first-party support for autonomous agent execution. However, this evidences delegated, one-off tasks rather than user-configured recurring or scheduled background automations. Automation API is only an SDK building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/recurring or event-triggered automation setup, evidence of tasks running unattended in the background, configuration docs for such automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: It handles dependencies, executes changes, and monitors outcomes automatically.
